title: SpiralCore v1 object capability descriptor
description: Authenticated-carrier/control-plane metadata or explicit pinned configuration. This JSON is not the SCMOBJ01 frame wire format, not peer authentication and not a new MVM envelope. The initial MVM adapter pins the full profile rather than exchanging this JSON on the wire.

codec_mask.description: Bits 0..9 are the stable mode IDs; Raw bit 0 is mandatory. No other bits are supported. Negotiate intersection only after carrier authentication/binding.
